thresholds.calibrated: Same held-out calibration rule, independent of evaluation

pairing: Every strategy uses the same resistance/read-noise stream for each profile and stored value; arithmetic reproduces original fixed-r1 counts. Original unpaired calibrated rows are retained separately.
phase_model: Independent resistance draws across WRITE_ZERO, WRITE_ONE and operation, held fixed within read burst.
policy: All usable replicas must agree; same-bit double fault in A+B.
